scientific_integrity: The proofs are symbolic and integral. Finite rational-rank tests supplement but do not replace them. Existing global matroid Gorenstein and face-count results are credited rather than claimed novel.
scientific_limitations: Only torus-fixed local class groups and the global canonical Cartier property are classified.
An equivalent unindexed historical local computation remains possible.
No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Local divisor classes and canonical boundaries for a one-circuit-hyperplane matroid toric variety
